text: The shell (.ops-app, header above routes) and the radar feed (head, filters, content stacked) should lay out in a column, but both are set to row. Change both to column and show the result.
command: cd /work/apps/canvas/src/ops && sed -i '2s/flex-direction: row/flex-direction: column/' ops.css && sed -i '96s/flex-direction: row/flex-direction: column/' radar.css && sed -n '2p' ops.css && sed -n '96p' radar.css
